{{Vanilla|Froglight}}
{{Infobox auto|Ochre Phosphor Lamp|title=Phosphor lamps}}
'''Phosphor lamps''' are light-emitting blocks in three colors: '''ochre''', '''verdant''' and '''pearlescent'''. They are the vanilla {{MCW|Froglight|froglights}} under new names, and they can be crafted from [[phosphor]] and [[glass]], so they no longer require leading frogs to magma cubes. They give light level 15, as in vanilla.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
Four phosphor and four glass around a dye make 4 lamps. The dye sets the color:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/ochre_froglight.json}}</ref>
{| class="wikitable"
! Lamp !! Dye
|-
| [[Ochre Phosphor Lamp]] || [[Dyes|Yellow dye]]
|-
| [[Verdant Phosphor Lamp]] || [[Dyes|Lime dye]]
|-
| [[Pearlescent Phosphor Lamp]] || [[Dyes|Magenta dye]]
|}
{{Recipes|Ochre Phosphor Lamp}}
{{Recipes|Verdant Phosphor Lamp}}
{{Recipes|Pearlescent Phosphor Lamp}}
The recipes unlock when the player picks up phosphor or glow lichen.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/phosphor.json}}</ref>

=== Mob loot ===
As in vanilla, a [[frog]] that eats a small magma cube produces a lamp: a temperate frog gives ochre, a cold frog verdant and a warm frog pearlescent.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/magma_cube.json}}</ref>

== Behavior ==
Phosphor lamps are mined fastest with a hoe or a pickaxe; the pack adds them to both tools' mineable lists.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/hoe.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/pickaxe.json}}</ref>
